update.notAllowed: Version {{version}} is available, but your license doesn't include it.

license.activateDescription: Enter the license key from your purchase email.
license.testProduct: Development build: use a test license key (TEST-…).

INVALID_KEY.title: License key not recognized
INVALID_KEY.description: The license key {{key}} doesn't exist. Check you copied it entirely from your purchase email.

EXPIRED.title: Your license expired
EXPIRED.description: Renew your license to keep using {{name}}, then click “I renewed my license”.

VERSION_NOT_ALLOWED.title: This version is not included
VERSION_NOT_ALLOWED.description: Your license includes {{name}} up to version {{version}}. Reinstall that version, or upgrade your license to use version {{current}}.
VERSION_NOT_ALLOWED.descriptionNone: Your license doesn't include version {{current}} of {{name}}. Upgrade your license to use it.
VERSION_NOT_ALLOWED.descriptionOffline: Your license doesn't include version {{current}} of {{name}}. Upgrade your license, or connect to the internet and check again.

MACHINE_LIMIT_REACHED.title: Too many computers
MACHINE_LIMIT_REACHED.description: Your license is already used on its maximum number of computers. Deactivate one in your account, then click “Check again”.

OFFLINE_EXPIRED.title: Connect to the internet
OFFLINE_EXPIRED.description: {{name}} needs to verify your license online. Connect to the internet, then click “Check again”.

CLOCK_TAMPERED.title: Check your date and time
CLOCK_TAMPERED.description: Your computer's date and time look wrong. Turn on “Set date and time automatically” in your system settings, then connect to the internet.

errors.not_found: This license key wasn't recognized. Check you copied it entirely from your purchase email.
errors.license_expired: This license expired. Renew it to use {{name}}.
errors.version_not_allowed: This license includes {{name}} up to version {{version}}. Upgrade it to use version {{current}}.
errors.version_not_allowed_none: This license doesn't include version {{current}} of {{name}}. Upgrade it to use this version.
errors.machine_limit_reached: This license is already used on its maximum number of computers. Deactivate one in your account to use it here.
errors.plan_limit_exceeded: Activation is temporarily unavailable. Try again later, or contact support.
errors.internal_error: Activation failed. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network_error: Couldn't reach the license server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.invalid_response: Activation failed. Check your computer's date and time are correct.
errors.unknown: Activation failed. Try again, or contact support.

license.offlineBanner: You're offline. Connect to the internet within {{duration}} to keep using {{name}}.

about.clockTampered: Your computer's date and time look wrong.
